description: Vehicles: prepare (unsigned) the purchase of an AIRCRAFT (model 4 Helicopter or 5 Private jet) for ETH: one transaction that sends exactly the on-chain ETH price (vehicle_shop shows ethPrice). The ETH goes to the project treasury wallet; what the project does with it is not promised. The Air Run is off: today an aircraft is a rare collectible and cannot be parked in a garage. Ground vehicles are NOT sold for ETH: use prepare_vehicle_buy for models 1 to 3.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_vehicle_buy_eth
